conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), the Comfort Club Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups per year, priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off all repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus members also get an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both Standard and Plus members get $500 off any full system replacement.
I thought it was $149?
The 2026 fee schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf) doesn't list a $149 membership price.
It shows Comfort Club at $189 per year for one system, or $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus at $269 per year, with Plus not offered monthly.

The only $149 in our documents is the after-hours emergency dispatch fee for non-members, which the 2026 Repair Price Book (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv) also lists and which is waived for members.
That may be where the $149 comes from, but I can't say for certain.
Hm. Okay.
The caller said "Hm.
Okay." which isn't a new question, so I'll add only what is relevant: the possible reason for a different price they remember.
The Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md) says existing members are locked at their enrollment price until their next renewal date, at which point the current price applies.
So if you enrolled at an earlier price, that rate holds until your renewal date.
The documents I have don't show a $149 membership price, and I can't say what price you enrolled at.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.

To get started, could you give me your full name, plus one of the following: your account number, your service address or your phone number?
Sure, my name is James Singh and my account number is MHC-13063.
Thank you, James.

I have three HVAC repair slots available for your AC:

Wednesday, October 21, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM; Friday, October 23, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM; or Saturday, October 24, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
Which one suits you best?
Friday, October 23, from 12 to 4 works for me.
Just to confirm, James: that's an HVAC repair on Friday, October 23, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
Can you give me a clear yes to go ahead and book it?
Yes, let's do that.
Booked: your HVAC repair visit on Friday, October 23, 12pm to 4pm, with Jun Park.
Yep, same one.
James, I see two appointments on your account: an HVAC repair on Saturday, October 17, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and an HVAC repair on Friday, October 23, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
Which one do you mean?
The Friday, October 23 one, 12 to 4.
Thanks, James.
Your HVAC repair is scheduled for Friday, October 23, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, with Jun Park.
Nope, that covers it.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.
